title: Walking Home with You Anime Reveals Visual, April 2027 Premiere
content: Walking Home with You anime revealed a new visual along with an April 2027 premiere date on Wednesday. No further details on the studio, staff, or cast were announced as of this writing. Mai Matsuda writes and illustrates the manga which the anime is based on.
author: Anime Corner

title: These 3 Zombie Anime Series Are the Pinnacle of the Genre (And They Have a Combined 48 Episodes)
content: The zombie genre has become one of the biggest in the entertainment medium, and the anime industry is no exception. In fact, anime has at least a couple dozen zombie series, offering a variety of choices that could continue to entertain as long as you are up for watching them.
author: ComicBook

title: You Are a Four Leaf Clover Romantic Suspense Manga Ends on October 15 (Updated)
content: Retailers are listing the 12th compiled book volume of Koushi 's You Are a Four Leaf Clover ( Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover ) manga as the final volume. The volume will ship on December 8.
author: ANN

title: 'I Don't Want to Be Killed by You, My Crown Prince!' Manga Enters Final Arc
content: Nao Oshiba revealed on X/Twitter on Tuesday that their I Don't Want to Be Killed by You, My Crown Prince! ( Ōtaishi-sama, Watashi Kondokoso Anata ni Korosareta Kunai ndesu! ) manga is entering its final arc and climax.
author: ANN

title: The Last Blossom Film Rescreens in Theaters on October 13 After Previous Screenings Had Incorrectly Timed Subtitles
content: GKIDS had initially planned to only screen the film on August 30-31. However, theatergoers had posted that English subtitles were off by several seconds during screenings for the first day, and some screenings had been cancelled for the second day. ANN reached out to GKIDS at the time.
author: ANN

title: New Shonen Jump Series Is the Mob Psycho Replacement Fans Never Knew They Needed
content: As the Fall 2026 anime season has arrived, the anime industry is seeing the release of new series, but Shonen Jump , as the leading manga magazine, is also bringing in new works.
author: ComicBook

title: Sony Pictures Entertainment Launches Crunchyroll Storyworks Division for Anime, Live-Action Adaptations
content: Crunchyroll Storyworks is seeking to provide projects that can be greenlit for HAYATE Inc., the new anime production venture from Aniplex and Crunchyroll . HAYATE Inc. was founded in March 2025 and is headquartered in Tokyo.
author: ANN

title: 20 Years Ago, Fans Never Expected to See This Dark Sci-Fi Anime Hit
content: Mecha has always been a huge genre within the anime community, with classic series like Mobile Suit Gundam and Evangelion becoming global phenomenons with staying power that’s nearly unmatched.
author: ComicBook

title: GKIDS Releases 100 Meters Anime Film on Blu-ray Disc on December 1
content: GKIDS announced on Wednesday that it will release the anime film of Uoto 's 100 Meters ( Hyakuemu ) manga on Blu-ray Disc on December 1. The Collector's Edition includes five art cards and a mini-poster. The disc release includes an interview with director Kenji Iwaisawa , a rotoscoping workshop, and scene breakdowns.
author: ANN
